summary: Register a statically understood DOM event listener with correct duplicate suppression and listener options.

semantics.options: capture, passive, once, signal; boolean third arg aliases capture
semantics.signal: already-aborted signal prevents registration; later abort removes listener
semantics.once: removed so it is invoked at most once

caveats: Callback identity must be JavaScript object/function identity, not delegate structural equality.
Listener invocation reuses existing FUNCTIONS calling semantics.

tests.name: duplicate registration suppressed despite option differences
tests.input: const t=new EventTarget(); let n=0; const f=()=>n++; t.addEventListener('x',f,{once:false}); t.addEventListener('x',f,{once:true}); t.dispatchEvent(new Event('x')); t.dispatchEvent(new Event('x')); console.log(n);
tests.expected_behavior: prints 2 because second registration with same type/callback/capture is not appended and does not replace options

tests.name: once listener fires once
tests.input: const t=new EventTarget(); let n=0; t.addEventListener('x',()=>n++,{once:true}); t.dispatchEvent(new Event('x')); t.dispatchEvent(new Event('x')); console.log(n);
